profile: Collegium Pharmaceutical commercializes prescription medicines in the United States for attention deficit hyperactivity disorder and moderate to severe pain, along with Symproic. Its products include Jornay PM, a stimulant for ADHD; Belbuca, a buprenorphine buccal film for persistent pain; Xtampza ER, an extended-release oxycodone formulation; and Nucynta immediate- and extended-release tapentadol products for acute or persistent pain.
